author: Omar_nawawy

title: Premium changes suck
body:
I get it was only 5 dollars for premium before, but thats like 80 EGP in my currency... I paid that to have premium features that now I must pay 600+ EGP to have again! That just sucks, I have so many subscription based services that it would be too much to pay 600+ just for a habit tracker yearly!! I payed 500 EGP to have a membership for a year on chess.com, and its worth it.. but paying 600 for habit tracking is not worth it in my book, and for like 99.999999% of Egyptians.. u need to adjust prices for Egypt even if it doesn’t get you that much profit.

And im still salty about the 80 EGP I payed, but at least I got about a yr of service for it.. the only thing I liked about this app compared to others is that there was no subscription.. now its just like the others smh.
